alt: Feet on the Ground, collage: two bare legs in white daisy sandals stand on grass among giraffe hide, a blackbird and a green chair.
description: Flat scan of the finished commission, portrait format. Two tanned legs drop in from the top edge and fill the centre, ending in white daisy-trimmed sandals on grass at the bottom, with giraffe-hide pieces behind them; a blackbird flies over grey storm cloud top left, a sculpted green chair and old books sit bottom left, garden grasses run down the right, and a tiny face in white sunglasses peeks out of the hedge bottom right. Edge to edge with no empty space, even light, very sharp; the focal point given is the feet.

alt: Wide collage in a carved black frame on a pale block wall, packed with magazine cut-outs: zebras, a tiger in a suit, a lighthouse, bathers.
description: One landscape-format Local Collage piece in a carved black frame, shot straight on and filling most of the picture, on a pale concrete-block wall. It is dense with magazine cut-outs: two zebras in a yellow circle, a leopard, a tiger's head on a houndstooth suit, a lighthouse, swimmers, a white mansion and headline scraps (one reads 'YOUR F#%King EX', bottom left). Only narrow strips of bare wall left and right; soft even light, sharp.

alt: Close-up of a framed collage corner: cut-out letters spell THE GLOBAL CANVAS over blue sky and clouds, beside clipped magazine text.
description: Tall close-up of the top-left corner of the larger framed Local Collage piece. Ransom-note letters spell 'THE GLOBaL CANVAS' over a blue and grey cloud photo, with two clipped strips of magazine text; the carved black frame fills the top quarter and is nearly black. Slightly soft and dim, and note the wording is 'Canvas', not the brand name.
words: Working with multiple elements, including collage, performance, and activism.
array of shapes, textures and details.
qualityNote: Soft focus and dim; the top quarter is near-black frame. Fine as a small detail, not large.

alt: Two collages in carved black frames on a pale block wall: a tall one on the left and a smaller wide one on the right.
description: Wide shot of two Local Collage pieces hung side by side on a pale concrete-block wall, taken slightly from the left so the tall left frame looms larger. The left piece is a dense portrait-format collage built around a face with cut-out eyes under a crown-like shape; the right is the landscape piece with the zebras and 'THE SUIT PARIS'. Bare wall fills the lower right quarter, with an orange strip in the bottom-right corner; even light, sharp.

alt: The Local Collage #3: The Butterfly Effect, collage on canvas in a deep black frame on a paint-splashed easel, outdoors on green turf.
description: A photo of the square piece in its deep black frame, not a flat scan: it stands on a paint-spattered easel on artificial grass, with fig leaves and a fence above and a grey container wall behind. The collage is a bright patchwork: a sun in sunglasses, penguins, a parrot, a woman in a pink dress, a dinosaur, big orange lettering, flowers, hand-drawn doodles and her logo sticker bottom right. The frame fills the middle, leaves take the top eighth and easel and turf the bottom fifth; open-shade daylight, sharp.

alt: Green neon sign reading THE GARDEN above six white-framed collages on a grey block wall, lit by a small barn lamp at night.
description: Portrait phone shot of the 2024 Tripping Animals wall at night, no flash. A big green neon 'THE GARDEN' sign runs across the upper third; below it six collages in white frames hang in two rows of three on a grey concrete-block wall, a gooseneck lamp glowing over the right-hand column (Lucky Pleasures, Reflections of Me and Let Out are among them). Dark ceiling above, and bare shadowy wall down the left third and along the bottom; moody and sharp.

alt: Six collages in white frames on a rough block wall, seen at an angle from the left, with orange spray paint between the nearest two.
description: Portrait phone shot taken close and at a steep angle along the 2024 Tripping Animals wall. The nearest frame, top left, holds Lucky Pleasures (a red collage of a figure in a bra with lips pasted over the eyes); below it is a black, white and red piece with a camera, and Let Out and Reflections of Me sit further along. Warm lamp light and strong texture in the blocks, with bulb reflections on the glass and dark pipes in the top right corner.

alt: Framed collages on two black picture ledges against a block wall, lit by flash; conduit and a fire alarm on the bare right side.
description: Flash photo of part of the right-hand group at the 2025 Tripping Animals show: collages in red, white and black frames leaning on two black ledges. Frames are cut off at the left edge and the right third is bare wall with conduit and red fire-alarm boxes. In view: Senor Tigre, Zenda Beach, Society, Small World, I Am the Bad Guy, Let Out and Blues.
words: KEEP YOUR EYES TO THE SKY
qualityNote: Direct flash with glare on the glass; frames cut off at the left edge; fire-alarm hardware in view. Small sizes only.

alt: Eight framed collages on two black ledges on a block wall, with an artist info sheet and QR code taped up at the left.
description: The best straight-on view of the left-hand group at the 2025 Tripping Animals show, all eight frames complete: Lucky Pleasures, Gaga's Offering, Candy and Reflections of Me above, Be You, Day # 25, Female Cactus and Stuck below. An artist info sheet with a small photo and QR code hangs at the left; at full size it shows the handle @theglobalcanvas, which is not the one on the site, so crop it out or keep it small. alt: Wide view of a block wall with two groups of framed collages on black ledges, a green neon THE GARDEN sign with an arrow, a pendant lamp.
description: Establishing shot of the whole 2025 Tripping Animals display: eight frames left of a dark red steel column, eleven on the right under a green neon 'THE GARDEN' sign with its full arrow. The top third is ceiling panels, a speaker, a pendant lamp and an orange mural arc top left; a green bar table cuts in bottom right and a wooden table bottom left. The frames are small in the picture, so it reads as a venue shot rather than a look at the art.
qualityNote: Flash-lit and a little flat; the top third is ceiling, speaker and lamp, so crop to the lower two thirds.

alt: Brewery wall with two groups of framed collages on black ledges, a green neon THE GARDEN sign, metal stools and a green table in front.
description: The most complete establishing shot of the 2025 Tripping Animals display, taken from further back: both groups of frames either side of a dark red steel column, the green neon sign upper right, concrete floor, three metal stools and a green-topped bar table lower right, a wooden table lower left. The frames sit in a band across the middle; the bottom third is floor and furniture and an orange mural arc fills the top-left corner. Flash-lit but level and sharp; the art itself is small.

alt: Block wall with two groups of framed collages on black ledges either side of a steel column, a green neon THE GARDEN sign above.
description: The same view as img-8899 from a step closer: eight frames left of the dark red column, eleven on the right, the neon sign above with its arrow cut off by the right edge. A stool and the green bar table sit along the bottom right, a wooden table bottom left, an orange mural arc top left. Flash-lit and slightly softer than img-8899.
qualityNote: Slightly soft and flash-lit; the neon arrow is cut off at the right edge. Prefer img-8899.
